snippet.title: Added a highly requested spell to my solo ARPG tonight - Glacial Core #actionrpg #indiedev #shorts
snippet.description: Latest addition to my solo-dev ARPG, Zukarii: Glacial Core. It's an unstable frost projectile that throws out shards of ice as it travels through enemies — happy with how it reads on screen. Still very much a work in progress, building this thing one system at a time and posting the milestones as they happen. More to come.
